questionsToConsider: Which three traits does your brand guide say you should have, and are they in the list?
Which trait pairs matter most for your market, such as serious and playful for a finance brand?
Do you want customers only, or also people who have just seen your marketing?
Who on your team owns the tone of voice and will act on what comes back?
guide.howToUseResponses: Before you read a single answer, mark on each slider where you intend the brand to sit. Then compare the average position with your mark, and look separately at customers and people who have only seen your ads, since a gap between those two groups usually points at the product experience rather than the marketing. The answers about where words and actions don't match are your to-do list: each one names a touchpoint that is off-voice.
customizeSteps: Swap the trait list for your own intended traits, and keep two or three unflattering ones so people can be honest.
Change the slider pairs to the tensions that matter for your brand, such as affordable and premium.
Send it by email or embed it on your site, then review the slider averages in the dashboard or export them to CSV.

faqs.q: What is a brand personality survey?
faqs.a: It asks people to describe your brand as if it were a person: its traits, its tone and how it behaves. It is about the brand's character, not the respondent's personality.

faqs.q: How is brand personality different from brand perception?
faqs.a: Perception covers what people think of you overall, including trust, value and quality. Personality focuses on character and voice, which is what your writing, design and service all express.

faqs.q: Why use sliders instead of a list of adjectives?
faqs.a: A slider between two opposites gives you a position you can compare over time and against your brand guidelines. Adjective lists are still useful, which is why this template asks for both.

faqs.q: Can I add my own traits and scales?
faqs.a: Yes. Use this template copies it into your account, where you can edit every question, add more sliders or change the trait list.
